name: Yomogida Shinji
source:
Shinji is a senior who is very intellectual and technological. He is very handsome and cool, and because of this, is very popular with girls. He always has the top grades and is the top-ranked student in the school. Being a bit obstinate, he often forms rivals with those that don't please him. His weak point is not using his specialties and his special ability is scheming.

[From [url=http://blgames.ukepile.com/database/empusa/empusa.php]Boys' Love Games Headquarters[/url]]
